methods.name: Legendre polynomials
methods.reason: These are the polynomial solutions of a Sturm–Liouville problem, so they form an orthogonal family.

steps.title: The equation it solves
steps.text: \(P_n\) is the polynomial solution of this equation, which arises when a boundary value problem is separated in the matching coordinates.

steps.title: Recurrence relation
steps.text: Each polynomial follows from the two before it, which is the practical way to generate them.

steps.title: Orthogonality
steps.text: Polynomials of different degree are orthogonal on the interval with this weight; that is what lets a function be expanded in them.

steps.title: Zeros
steps.text: It has 3 distinct real zeros, all inside the interval \((-1,\ 1)\).

steps.title: Check
steps.text: The polynomial satisfies its differential equation, and the orthogonality integrals were confirmed numerically.

methods.verify_note: The polynomial satisfies its differential equation, and the orthogonality integrals were confirmed numerically.
